thread:
Iris (Docs): Putting up a small PR to unify guidance for 429s, timeouts, and context-trim fallbacks. Need short SDK snippets, harness logs, and recommended end-user copy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512
Noah (SDK): I'll add 3 tiny snippets: Python, TS, and Go. Will show Retry-After precedence and X-Redwood-Retry-Window handling. Path: docs/snippets/err-ref/429-timeouts/.
Asha (eng-runtime): Note: runtime will sometimes return a 429 with only X-Redwood-Retry-Window for <2s windows. Add guidance: for very short retry windows, prefer jittered immediate retry; for longer windows, prefer backoff or fallback to a quantized model.
Riley (QA): I'll attach a minimal harness demonstrating context-limit -> timeout -> 429 cascade. Will sanitize output and include curl + node replay. File will live at docs/err-ref/examples/429-timeouts/harness-playbook.md.
Iris (Docs): Can we agree on end-user microcopy? Suggested: "Service is busy — please try again in a few seconds." Keep it short.
Noah (SDK): LGTM. I'll make code very compact (<=10 lines) and add comment about parsing HTTP-date in Retry-After if numeric parse fails.
Asha (eng-runtime): Add a short bullet list explaining fallback ordering: same-pool quantized variants -> region fallback -> queue/backoff -> error. Helps product teams design graceful degradation.
Iris (Docs): Perfect. Tagging @Noah and @Asha for final quick review before merge. ux-bot: Reminder: include accessibility note if surfaced in UI.
Iris (Docs): Merging after one SDK + runtime thumbs up. Thanks!
